label: D2 arrival at S2 via common a2, early in episode, after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and only when the reached state shown is S2 (100% of mass); 96% of mass on a2 choices, so almost always a common a2->S2 transition. It never fires at D1 or GO, never at S1, and never after ep_trial ~40 (none in trials 40-99, 51% of mass in trials 0-9), so it reflects a slow early-episode hidden-state drift. Within that, it is strongly gated by an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward==0: 93% of mass; inactive or tiny when recent trials were rewarded, largest after runs of unrewarded trials). Top activations are ~0.9-1.0 after r0 a2 S2c/S2R in the first trials of an episode. Also correlates with high value and choice logit favouring a2. All variables are observed at D2. Dev F1 0.63 (precision 0.56, recall 0.72, mass recall 0.89); dropping action==2 gives F1 0.56, mass recall 0.92. The ep_trial gate is a proxy for an unidentified slow internal state, so the explanation is incomplete.
